description: Ministry of Defence - General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University Order to declare on 06 July 2018 as the date on which the Provisions of this Act shall Come in to Operation
categorisation: This gazette content announces the commencement date of the "General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University (Special Provisions) Act, No. 17 of 2018" through a ministerial order. It deals with the implementation of a specific law (Act No. 17 of 2018), which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions a named individual (Maithripala Sirisena) and his ministerial title, the primary purpose is legal/regulatory - bringing a specific act into operation - rather than being about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
